member.name: T:SMRUCC.genomics.InteractionModel.AracneDpi
member.summary:
ARACNe-style network inference step (Margolin et al., BMC Bioinformatics 2006): build a mutual-information adjacency, then apply the Data Processing Inequality (DPI) triplet filter.
DPI: in a triangle (i, j, k), if x_i regulates x_j through x_k then MI(i,j) < MI(i,k) and MI(i,j) < MI(j,k); the weakest edge is therefore likely indirect. An edge is removed only when it is more than tolerance (default 0.1, ARACNe's ε) below BOTH other edges — near-ties are kept.

member.name: M:SMRUCC.genomics.InteractionModel.AracneDpi.Filter(System.Double[0:,0:],System.Double,System.Double)
member.summary: DPI triplet filter. The adjacency is weights(i,j) > threshold (symmetric, diagonal ignored); removals are all evaluated against the ORIGINAL adjacency (single pass, like the reference ARACNe code). For every triangle, the weakest edge is removed when w_min < (1 − tolerance)·w_other1 AND w_min < (1 − tolerance)·w_other2.
